title: Why bootstrapped startups demand obsession and sacrifice, not balance
summary: Jason Cohen argues that a bootstrapped company consumes all available time, and that maximizing the chance of success means putting work before health and family for a period. He frames it as a deliberate, time-boxed tradeoff best made when you have few dependents and enough savings, not a lifelong lifestyle.

principles.text: A bootstrapped company will absorb all your time, because there's always more to do than the few people running it.
principles.quote: How much time does a bootstrapped company take? All of it.

principles.text: Small-company success takes obsession, not just passion: you can't stop working, and your whole self is at stake.
principles.quote: It takes obsession to make a little company go. Forget "passion"--everyone's favorite word--it's "obsession." It's not just that you love working, it's that you can't stop working.

principles.text: Maximizing your odds as a small-business founder means sacrificing health and family, at least for a while.
principles.quote: Maximizing your chance for success means sacrificing health and family.

principles.text: Time-box the sacrifice and choose the right life stage: do it when you have no kids, enough savings to risk, and an understanding partner.
principles.quote: I did all this in my 20's when I had no kids, I had enough savings to risk everything for a while, and I had a wife who had her own business and who therefore understood how much work it took

principles.text: Work-life balance advice is right in general but doesn't describe the early startup phase; decide consciously whether to pay the penalty now.
principles.quote: You need to accept that this is going to happen and ask whether it's OK to incur this penalty right now.

principles.text: More hours alone don't produce more output, but optimizing how you spend time can multiply productivity.
principles.quote: Indeed, study after study has shown that "working more hours" doesn't translate into "accomplishing more shit."
